facts.text: The swelling and pain in my right knee have gotten worse recently.

facts.item: right knee pain: better with rest
facts.text: The pain gets a lot better when I rest.
My left knee was swollen like this a few weeks ago, but it has gotten better since.
The pain makes it hard for me to walk.
The pain makes it hard to do my daily activities.
It's persistent; it doesn't go away.
My back pain also makes it harder for me to move around.
I've been using special shampoos to manage my dandruff.
I was diagnosed with arthritis 16 years ago.
I don't have any other significant medical problems.
I'm frustrated by how much my symptoms limit me.
I don't have any other symptoms in the rest of my body.

findings.name: knee examination
findings.result: Inspection: visible swelling of the right knee. Palpation: warmth and tenderness over the right knee joint; no similar findings in the left knee. Range of motion: reduced in the right knee due to pain and swelling.

findings.name: back examination
findings.result: Limited spine mobility, without acute tenderness.

findings.name: right knee X-ray
findings.result: Joint space narrowing, subchondral sclerosis, and no evidence of erosive disease.

findings.name: spine X-ray
findings.result: Slight degenerative changes; no evidence of sacroiliitis.

leakage.reason: 'Arthritis' is the patient's own prior diagnosis from the source past medical history (type unspecified); it is part of the gold term but is history the patient was told.

source_issues: The knee X-ray (joint space narrowing, subchondral sclerosis, no erosions) and the spine X-ray (degenerative changes) look osteoarthritic; no psoriatic skin plaques are documented, only dandruff and nail pitting, so the case supports the gold diagnosis weakly.
Social_History carries no information ('Does not provide specific details on lifestyle, smoking, or alcohol use').
notes: The chief complaint names two complaints (right knee swelling and pain), both in the opening. The recent worsening applies to both and is a standalone fact (f003); relief with rest is attached to the pain, as in the source.
Difficulty walking and difficulty with daily activities (p005) are split into two facts.
The inspection leaf e005 mixes knee swelling and nail pitting, so it is cited by both the knee examination (x005) and a separate nail examination (x006).
ESR and CRP are not one of the listed standard panels, so they stay separate records; so do rheumatoid factor and anti-CCP.
Frustration with his limitations is kept as a social_background fact (the patient's own feeling), not a psychiatric symptom.

excluded_sources.reason: Meta statement with no content ('Does not provide specific details on lifestyle, smoking, or alcohol use'); smoking and alcohol stay unknown.

extras.objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with knee swelling and pain, who has a history of arthritis and additional musculoskeletal complaints.
